verdict.rationale: Fin's own docs state it 'works through MCP or API Data Connectors for your business tools' (docs-40/54) and explicitly describe connecting the 'Zapier MCP connector to Fin' (intdir-3), confirming Fin can consume external MCP servers as tools.
